title: 第一卷 第7章 飞燕洗脚
slug: 满门遗孀花甲老汉粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这次，林骁拿来两种药。

一锅是治伤寒的，一锅是治肺疾的。

药香混着水汽，在屋里弥漫开来。

他先盛了一碗，端到炕边：“馨月，喝了，发发汗。”

苏馨月撑起身，接过药碗，眼圈又红了：“谢林伯。”

“趁热喝。”

林骁转身，又盛了一碗，递给冷清雪。

冷清雪一愣，下意识道：“我没事。”

“你没事就不会咳个不停了。”林骁语气严肃，“肺疾不能拖，我不想看你年纪轻轻就香消玉殒。”

上官飞燕忙接过药碗，捧到冷清雪面前：“冷姐姐，你就听林伯的，乖乖吃药吧，你最近咳得是越来越勤了。”

冷清雪看着那碗深褐色的药汁，沉默片刻，伸手接过，低声道：“谢林伯。”

她仰头，一饮而尽，眉头都没皱一下。

“好了，喝完药就歇着。”林骁摆摆手，收拾药罐。

“林伯，您吃点东西吧？”苏馨月忙道。

“不吃了，累了。”林骁将药罐放好，转身要走。

“那……我们去睡偏房吧，您回正屋睡。”苏馨月实在不忍心看林骁睡偏房了。

林骁摇头：“偏房炕小，睡不下你们三个，你和清雪都有病在身，就在这儿好好养着。”

“可偏房太冷了……”

“无妨，”林骁笑了笑，“老头子不怕冷。”

他说完，推门出去，带进一阵冷风。

苏馨月看着关上的门，心里揪得发疼。

上官飞燕沉思良久，今晚决定做些什么。

过了一会儿，她主动端了盆热水，往门外走。

“飞燕，你去哪儿？”苏馨月关切问。

“我……”上官飞燕脚步一顿，闷声道，“去给林老头洗个脚，来回几十里山路，肯定累坏了。”

苏馨月一怔，随即欣慰地笑了：“飞燕，你不是一直讨厌林伯吗？”

“我、我是讨厌啊！”上官飞燕咬咬唇，“但一码归一码，这次欠他的，我去还恩。”

她端着水盆，头也不回地走向偏房。

“咚咚。”

“进。”

上官飞燕推门进去，反手关上门。

她将水盆放在地上，挺直腰板，一副傲娇模样：“老头，我来给你洗脚。”

林骁正脱棉衣，闻言一愣，笑了：“你帮我洗脚？这么好心？不会有什么阴谋吧？”

“我这人恩怨分明。”上官飞燕蹲下身，仰头看他，眼神认真，“有恩报恩，有仇报仇。”

林骁坐下，脱了鞋袜。

一股酸臭味扑面而来。

上官飞燕脸色一僵，下意识捏住鼻子，嫌弃的表情藏都藏不住。

“怎么，嫌弃我老头子？”林骁挑眉。

“不、不会！”上官飞燕屏住呼吸，硬着头皮道，“走几十里山路，臭是正常的。”

她伸手，捧起林骁的脚，浸入热水。

脚底板磨出厚厚的老茧，脚趾关节粗大，是常年行走劳作的痕迹。

她的手很嫩，动作笨拙，但洗得认真。

温热的水漫过脚背，林骁舒服地叹了口气。

洗完，擦干。

This time, Lin Xiao brought two kinds of medicine.

One pot is used to treat typhoid fever, and the other pot is used to treat lung diseases.

The aroma of medicine mixed with water vapor filled the room.

He filled a bowl first and brought it to the Kang: "Xinyue, drink it and make you sweat."

Su Xinyue stood up and took the medicine bowl, her eyes red again: "Thank you, Uncle Lin."

"Drink it while it's hot."

Lin Xiao turned around, filled another bowl and handed it to Leng Qingxue.

Leng Qingxue was stunned and said subconsciously: "I'm fine."

"If you are fine, you won't stop coughing." Lin Xiao said in a serious tone, "The lung disease cannot be delayed. I don't want to see you die at a young age."

Shangguan Feiyan hurriedly took the medicine bowl and held it in front of Leng Qingxue: "Sister Leng, just listen to Uncle Lin and take the medicine. You have been coughing more and more frequently recently."

Leng Qingxue looked at the bowl of dark brown concoction, remained silent for a moment, reached out to take it, and whispered: "Xie Linbo."

She raised her head and drank it all in one gulp without even frowning.

"Okay, let's take a rest after drinking the medicine." Lin Xiao waved his hand and put away the medicine jar.

"Uncle Lin, would you like to have something to eat?" Su Xinyue asked hurriedly.

"I won't eat anymore. I'm tired." Lin Xiao put the medicine jar away and turned to leave.

"Then... let's go sleep in the side room, and you go back to the main room to sleep." Su Xinyue really couldn't bear to see Lin Xiao sleeping in the side room.

Lin Xiao shook his head: "The Kang in the side room is too small to sleep the three of you. You and Qingxue are both sick, so just take good care of yourself here."

"But the side room is too cold..."

"It doesn't matter," Lin Xiao smiled, "The old man is not afraid of the cold."

After he finished speaking, he opened the door and went out, bringing in a gust of cold wind.

Su Xinyue looked at the closed door, her heart aching.

Shangguan Feiyan thought for a long time and decided what to do tonight.

After a while, she took the initiative to bring a basin of hot water and walked out the door.

"Feiyan, where are you going?" Su Xinyue asked with concern.

"I..." Shangguan Feiyan paused and said in a low voice, "I'm going to wash Old Man Lin's feet. I must be exhausted after traveling dozens of miles back and forth through the mountains."

Su Xinyue was startled, then smiled happily: "Feiyan, haven't you always hated Uncle Lin?"

"I, I hate it!" Shangguan Feiyan bit her lip, "But one code equals another, I owe him this time, and I will repay him."

She held the basin and walked towards the side room without looking back.

"Dong dong."

"Come in."

Shangguan Feiyan pushed the door in and closed the door behind her back.

She placed the basin on the ground, straightened her back, and said with a proud look: "Old man, let me wash your feet."

Lin Xiao was taking off his cotton-padded clothes. He was startled when he heard this and smiled: "You wash my feet? Are you so kind? There can't be any conspiracy, right?"

"I am a person with a clear distinction between grudges and grudges." Shangguan Feiyan knelt down and looked up at him with serious eyes, "Repay kindness with kindness and revenge with hatred."

Lin Xiao sat down and took off his shoes and socks.

A sour smell hit my face.

Shangguan Feiyan's face stiffened and she subconsciously pinched her nose, unable to hide her disgusted expression.

"Why, do you dislike me, old man?" Lin Xiao raised his eyebrows.

"No, no!" Shangguan Feiyan held her breath and said bravely, "It's normal to smell bad after walking dozens of miles on a mountain road."

She reached out, picked up Lin Xiao's feet, and dipped them into the hot water.

The soles of the feet have thick calluses and the toe joints are thick, the marks of years of walking and labor.

Her hands are very tender and her movements are clumsy, but she washes them carefully.

The warm water covered the insteps, and Lin Xiao sighed comfortably.

After washing, dry.
